optionRationales.reason: The objects are on the far side of the hall.：遠處複數支持 those。
The objects are in the speaker's bag.：這支持 these。
One object is in the speaker's hand.：這支持 this。
The noun is singular and nearby.：這支持 this。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「在複數對象中，以群組邊界、說話者視角與近遠線索選 these 或 those，並維持複數名詞及 be 一致。」可推出 The objects are on the far side of the hall.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The objects are on the far side of the hall. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
